title: Scoped timers
description:
Time sections of code with RAII and print a summary.

```
update   avg 2.1 ms  max 3.4 ms  (120 calls)
render   avg 9.8 ms  max 14.0 ms (120 calls)
physics  avg 1.0 ms  (inside update)
```
hints: Store the start time in the constructor and add the difference in the destructor (lesson 8.08).
`#define PROFILE_SCOPE(n) ScopedTimer timer_##__LINE__{n}` needs one more macro level to paste the line number; or use `__COUNTER__`.
requirements: A global table of name to count, total and max.
A `PROFILE_SCOPE(name)` macro that makes a uniquely named timer.
stretch: Show nesting by keeping a stack of open timers.
